meta.title: When Procol's server is down, the approver is told to try again
gaps: Stop or block Procol's backend for several minutes
Log in to Asha's mailbox, open the Procol approval email, click Approve, and send the unchanged Action:Approve email
Wait for Procol to read the mailbox and verify the approval is later recorded or can be retried
